suppress.notes: CVE-2017-1000248 is for the Ruby redis-store project (redis-store/redis-store), not org.springframework.ai:spring-ai-redis-store. The CPE match is a false positive. Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-1000248 Review by 2027-07-26.

CVE-2025-15104 is for the Nu Html Checker project (validator/validator), not org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator. The generic "validator" CPE match is a false positive. Source: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-15104 Review by 2027-07-26.

CVE-2021-4236 is for the Go module github.com/ecnepsnai/web, not io.zipkin.aws:brave-propagation-aws. The generic "web" CPE match is a false positive. Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-4236 Review by 2027-07-26.
